biography: Darin Phillips, a name whispered with a mix of awe and trepidation in Caterham circles, hails from the grimy industrial heartland of Birmingham. His path to motorsport was as unorthodox as his aggressive driving style. Unlike many who started in karting, Darin cut his teeth on the illegal street racing scene of the West Midlands, honing his reflexes and fearlessness dodging traffic and outmaneuvering the local constabulary. One fateful night, after narrowly avoiding a head-on collision with a milk float (a story he still recounts with a glint in his eye), Darin decided to channel his talents into a more legitimate, albeit still adrenaline-fueled, pursuit. He entered a local Caterham race on a whim, using prize money from a pool tournament to fund his entry. Despite a disastrous qualifying session, he clawed his way through the field, finishing third and announcing his arrival in no uncertain terms. Now, at 33, Darin is a seasoned Caterham racer, known for his relentless pursuit of victory and his unwavering refusal to yield an inch on the track.
drivingStyle: Phillips is a driver who lives on the ragged edge. His corner entry speeds are borderline suicidal, relying on late braking and fearless commitment to carry him through. Tire management is not his forte; he prefers to extract every last ounce of grip from his tires in the early laps, often leaving him struggling for pace in the closing stages. Under pressure, Darin either crumbles spectacularly or elevates his game to an entirely new level, making him a wildly unpredictable, but thrilling, competitor.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at Brands Hatch in 2021, where Darin accused Marcus of deliberately taking him out of the race.
A clash of personalities and driving styles. Isabelle, known for her clinical precision, often criticizes Darin's reckless abandon, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.
A rivalry built on sheer competitiveness. Both drivers are fiercely ambitious and consistently vying for the top spot, resulting in numerous wheel-to-wheel battles and near misses.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of mismatched socks (one red, one blue) for every race.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track ('Ace of Spades' by Motorhead) exactly three times before getting into the car.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee with three sugars precisely 30 minutes before the start of any race.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser."
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham 620R Championship at Oulton Park in 2022 after a nail-biting final race where he overtook his main rival on the last corner.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Silverstone in 2020, due to a mechanical failure, costing him valuable championship points.
